params.message:
A withdrawal is a history, not a field

The same run was misjudged twice today: first against a reading from before
the merge, then against one that read a redirect instead of the page behind
it. The first correction fitted in wasVerdict; the second was refused,
because one field holds one withdrawal, and the record kept a verdict
everybody knew to be wrong.

So withdrawals is a list: every verdict that was passed keeps its evidence,
its reason and its moment. Two mistakes, two entries, and the run returns
to unjudged each time so the next reading decides it.
